My order arrived and one item is damaged, what do I do?

I'm sorry to hear your order arrived damaged! Here's what you should do:
Document the Damage Take clear photos of:
The damaged packaging itself
The entire product and close-ups of the affected areas
A common object near the damage to show scale
The law tag showing the barcode (both front and back if available)
Note the date you unboxed the item.
Contact Our Support Team Reach out to our customer support team with:
Your order details and email address
Your current shipping address
The photos and description of the damage
Our team will review your documentation and guide you through the next steps. Processing time for replacement requests may take up to 7 business days, not including any production time needed to make the item.
If the item needs to be returned, you'll receive a prepaid return shipping label via email. You can continue using the product while waiting for a replacement if applicable.
